name: Surat Jalan and Delivery Order Generator

parameters.jsCode:
const sj = $input.first().json; const itemsRows = sj.items.map(i => `${i.no}${i.kode_barang}${i.nama_barang}${i.satuan}${i.jumlah}${i.keterangan}` ).join(''); const html = `
${sj.pengirim_nama}
${sj.pengirim_alamat} | Tel: ${sj.pengirim_telepon}

SURAT JALAN

No: ${sj.nomor_surat_jalan} | Tanggal: ${sj.tanggal} | Ref PO: ${sj.nomor_po}

Pengirim

${sj.pengirim_nama}

${sj.pengirim_alamat}

Tel: ${sj.pengirim_telepon}

Penerima

${sj.penerima_nama}

${sj.penerima_alamat}

${sj.penerima_kota}

Tel: ${sj.penerima_telepon}

Ekspedisi: ${sj.ekspedisi} | No. Resi: ${sj.no_resi}

${itemsRows}
NoKodeNama BarangSatuanJumlahKeterangan
Total Barang:${sj.total_barang}
${sj.catatan ? `
Catatan: ${sj.catatan}
` : ''}

Pengirim

(_______________)

Kurir/Ekspedisi

(_______________)

Penerima

(_______________)

`; return [{json: {html: html, ...sj}}];

parameters.subject: =Surat Jalan {{ $json.nomor_surat_jalan }} - {{ $json.pengirim_nama }}

parameters.content:
## Surat Jalan / Delivery Order Generator

### Generates:
- Professional Surat Jalan HTML document
- Auto-numbered: SJ/YYYYMMDD/XXX
- Pengirim & Penerima details
- Item table with kode barang, satuan, jumlah
- Signature boxes (Pengirim, Kurir, Penerima)
- Logs to Google Sheets tracking
- Emails notification to customer

### Webhook Payload:
```json
{
  "po_number": "PO/2024/001",
  "pengirim": {"nama": "PT. ABC", "alamat": "...", "telepon": "..."},
  "penerima": {"nama": "Toko XYZ", "alamat": "...", "kota": "Surabaya", "telepon": "..."},
  "ekspedisi": "JNE REG",
  "items": [{"sku": "SKU001", "nama": "Produk A", "satuan": "pcs", "qty": 10}]
}
```
